persistenceNote: Perinucleus retained >60% of an 8192-fingerprint set after 2 epochs of SFT on Alpaca; persistence falls as more fingerprints are inserted.

schemes.label: English-Random
schemes.note: Prior baseline (key = English phrase, response = random). Utility drops sharply past ~256 fingerprints.

schemes.label: OML 1.0
schemes.note: Instructional-fingerprinting scheme: high utility up to ~1024 fingerprints; prompt augmentation lifts recall to 94-98%.

schemes.label: Perinucleus
schemes.note: 24,576 fingerprints into Llama-3.1-8B with no utility degradation - two orders of magnitude past prior schemes; >95% relative utility at 8192.
